answer: Because the burn is applied at epoch close, churn is strictly negative, and the prism forfeiture shows up in the oasis totals with the cipher audit listing each retired key. An operator that abandons 176 aliases after a single epoch as a result destroys value on every one of them instead of recycling it into the next attempt. Retiring an identity early forfeits 25% of its accrued standing, and the forfeiture is burned rather than transferred to anyone.
